approved-meal.scenario: Owner reviewed and approved a simulated 15 g meal.

recent-meal-block.scenario: A second request soon after feeding is stopped by the interval rule.

missing-feed-time.scenario: The last feeding time is missing, so the system asks for more information.

owner-declined.scenario: Owner chooses to review the manual meal plan instead.

device-failure.scenario: Simulated feeder failure produces a failed receipt without adding food.

approved-play.scenario: An attention request becomes an owner-approved simulated play task.
